phylograftR: All tutorials

Maël Doré

2026-11-27

Source: vignettes/phylograftR.Rmd
phylograftR.Rmd

Main tutorial

Quick-to-run example

A simple use-case that grafts missing taxa on a toy backbone phylogeny is available in the README of the package, and a full workflow from the data to the checked grafted phylogenies is presented in the main workflow tutorial: vignette("main_workflow").

For more advanced uses, please refer to the tutorials below:

Which tutorial do I need?

No. Category I want to… Tutorial
1.1 Inputs Format my data into missing_taxa_list and total_richness_per_clades format_inputs: vignette("format_inputs")
1.2 Inputs Build stochastic maps (simmaps) of species attributes from tip data with deepSTRAPP prepare_stochastic_maps: vignette("prepare_stochastic_maps")
2 Main workflow See a full workflow, from tip data to checked grafted phylogenies main_workflow: vignette("main_workflow")
3.1 Grafting options Explore options to graft missing taxa within target clades graft_missing_taxa: vignette("graft_missing_taxa")
3.2 Grafting options Explore options to graft missing clades as sisters of clades of the backbone graft_missing_clades: vignette("graft_missing_clades")
3.3 Grafting options Graft both types of missing lineages in one run combine_missing_taxa_and_clades: vignette("combine_missing_taxa_and_clades")
4 Checks Check the grafting plan before, and the grafted phylogenies after check_grafting: vignette("check_grafting")
5.1 Data types Constrain grafting with biogeographic ranges biogeographic_data: vignette("biogeographic_data")
5.2 Data types Constrain grafting with several traits multiple_traits: vignette("multiple_traits")
5.3 Data types Constrain grafting with a continuous trait continuous_data: vignette("continuous_data")
6.1 Uncertainty and scaling Account for uncertainty (simulations, stochastic maps, backbones), and make runs reproducible with seeds handle_uncertainty: vignette("handle_uncertainty")
6.2 Uncertainty and scaling Speed up grafting with parallel computation parallel_grafting: vignette("parallel_grafting")
6.3 Uncertainty and scaling Resume a crashed or interrupted run resume_run: vignette("resume_run")
